rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for unwanted noise, including general technical noise.

example.english: The noise from the next-door flat kept me from sleeping.
example.traditional: 隔離屋嘅噪音搞到我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: gaak3 lei4 uk1 ge3 cou3 jam1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this for mixed, extraneous, or irregular sounds when emphasizing that they interfere with the desired sound.

example.english: The radio has a lot of noise, so I can't hear clearly.
example.traditional: 個收音機有好多雜音，聽唔清楚。
example.jyutping: go3 sau1 jam1 gei1 jau5 hou2 do1 zaap6 jam1 teng1 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this for the neutral sense of any sound, without implying that it is unpleasant.

example.english: I heard a noise outside the door.
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou2 mun4 ngoi6 jau5 sing1 jam1

rows.note: Use this technical term for unwanted signal or data components and random variation in measurements or systems.

example.english: This sensor's data has too much noise.
example.traditional: 呢個感測器嘅數據有太多雜訊。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gam2 caak1 hei3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 jau5 taai3 do1 zaap6 seon3
